68:1: Nun; by the pen and what they write.
68:2: You are not, by the favor of your Rabb, a madman.
68:3: And indeed, for you is an uninterrupted reward.
68:4: And indeed, you are upon a magnificent character.
68:5: You will see and they will see,
68:6: Which of you is afflicted with fitnah?
68:7: Indeed, your Rabb is best aware of the one who strays from His path, and He is best aware of those who are guided.
68:8: So do not obey the deniers.
68:9: They wish that you would be soft so that they too would be soft.
68:10: And do not obey every swearer of many oaths, despicable,
68:11: Backbiter with his tongue, carrier of slander, walking gossiper,
68:12: Much hinderer of good, aggressive, sinful,
68:14: Because he was an owner of wealth and sons.
68:15: When Our verses were recited to him, he said: "Legends of the ancients."
68:16: We will brand upon his snout.
68:17: Indeed, We tested them just as We tested the owners of the garden, when they swore that they would surely harvest it in the morning,
68:18: And they were not making an exception.
68:19: An encircler from your Rabb circulated over it while they were sleeping.
68:21: So in the morning they called out to one another,
68:22: Saying: "Go out early to your crop, if you are to gather fruit."
68:23: So they set out, and they were whispering to one another,
68:24: "That no destitute person shall enter it upon you today at all."
68:25: And they went early, capable of prevention.
68:26: When they saw it, they said: "Indeed, we are led astray."
68:28: The middle one of them said: "Did I not say to you, if only you had glorified?"
68:29: They said: "Exalted is our Rabb, indeed we were wrongdoers."
68:30: Thereupon they began blaming one another.
68:31: They said: "Woe to us! Indeed, we were transgressors."
68:32: "Perhaps our Rabb will give us better than it in exchange. Indeed, we are turners to our Rabb."
68:33: Such is the punishment; and surely the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
68:34: Indeed, for the possessors of taqwa there are gardens of bliss with their Rabb.
68:35: Shall We make the Muslims like the criminals?
68:36: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
68:37: Or is there for you a book from which you learn?
68:38: Indeed, in it for you is whatever you choose.
68:39: Or do you have oaths binding upon Us until the Day of Resurrection? Indeed, for you is whatever you judge.
68:40: Ask them which of them is a guarantor for this.
68:41: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they are truthful.
68:42: That Day the shin will be bared and they are called to prostrate, but they are not able.
68:43: Their eyes cast down, humiliation covering them; and yet they were called to prostrate while they were sound.
68:44: Leave Me and those who deny this discourse. We will draw them on step by step from where they do not know.
68:45: And I give them respite; indeed, My plan is firm.
68:46: Or do you ask them for a fee so that they are burdened with debt?
68:47: Or is the ghayb with them so that they are writing?
68:48: So be patient for the judgment of your Rabb and do not be like the companion of the fish, when he called out while he was distressed.
68:49: Had not a favor from his Rabb reached him, he would have been cast upon the bare ground while reproached.
68:50: His Rabb chose him and made him among the righteous.
68:51: And those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the reminder, and they say: "Indeed, he is a madman."
68:52: And it is not except a reminder for the worlds.
